Overview.Name: Sirikonda Pallavi
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Maintaining a healthy routine and improving overall energy

Meal_1 (Main Lunch Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g)
Meal_2 (Dinner): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd + cucumber salad
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg bhurji (2 eggs)

Notes_and_Tips: Keep meals simple and follow similar timings daily since fixed routine works better for you.
Reduce fried outside foods and replace them with roasted or home-cooked options.
Morning sunlight exposure and regular yoga will help improve energy and recovery.
Avoid stress eating by drinking water or buttermilk before taking extra snacks.
Keep dinner balanced and home-cooked for better digestion and energy.
